title: Profile of Those who Seek Help from Service Agents at MRT Stations
what_it_is: Profile of Those who Seek Help from Service Agents at MRT Stations

sections.label: Cash top-up service withdrawal
sections.summary: The cash top-up service at Passenger Service Centres is being withdrawn, with 150 service agents deployed at MRT stations to help commuters with ticketing machines.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: What is gradually being withdrawn is the cash top-up service at the Passenger Service Centre (PSC).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: To help commuters make adjustments, some 150 service agents are deployed at MRT stations to help commuters with the ticketing machines.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The service agents helped a few hundred commuters per day in the beginning, but the number has since come down significantly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Based on our sample count, the estimated breakdown of these commuters who needed help is: 42% seniors, 35% working adults, 19% foreign workers and 4% others.

sections.label: Flexible approach to technology adoption
sections.summary: A flexible and patient approach is taken, with the philosophy that technology must help consumers, though consumers need some nudging.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: So, they came back and we helped them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: We take a very flexible and patient approach.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: My philosophy is quite simple: technology must help us and help consumers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: We should not try to get consumers to change in order to fit technology, especially if it is difficult.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But, at the same time, I think consumers do need some nudging.
